$comment: Korean data values for the fulfillment pilot. The CSVs stay in English; these replacements run on the copied TMDL when the report is built in Korean. Values that measures compare against (Processes[Flow]) are not renamed.

tmdl.replace:
"en-US"),
				    Named = Table.TransformColumns(Typed, {{"Process", each Record.FieldOrDefault([Pick = "피킹", Pack = "패킹", #"Sort & ship" = "분류·출고", Receive = "입고 검수", Putaway = "적치", #"Cycle count" = "재고 실사"], _, _)}})
				in
				    Named

"en-US"),
				    Named = Table.TransformColumns(Typed, {{"Zone", each Record.FieldOrDefault([#"Zone A" = "A 구역", #"Zone B" = "B 구역", #"Zone C" = "C 구역", Dock = "도크"], _, _)}})
				in
				    Named

"en-US"),
				    Named = Table.TransformColumns(Typed, {{"Shift", each Record.FieldOrDefault([Day = "주간", Night = "야간"], _, _)}})
				in
				    Named

"en-US"),
				    Named = Table.TransformColumns(Typed, {{"Carrier", each Record.FieldOrDefault([#"Parcel A" = "택배사 A", #"Parcel B" = "택배사 B", #"Own fleet" = "자체 배송"], _, _)}})
				in
				    Named

tmdl.find: "Below standard", [Hours Below Standard], "Indirect work", [Indirect Hours], "Idle", [Idle Hours]
tmdl.replace: "표준 미달 작업", [Hours Below Standard], "간접 작업", [Indirect Hours], "대기", [Idle Hours]
